mem_note: Omit -m: the esp32c3 machine sets its own 400 KB, matching the chip's SRAM.
qemu_args_note: strap-mode is not optional: 0x8 selects SPI boot on this chip and the 0x4 default drops the ROM into download mode.

pins.note: GPIO9 carries MISO and the boot strap on this board.

status: boots, mounts SPIFFS, brings up the radio and answers its CLI over the emulated USB console.
